body_text:
For a bounded function $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb{R}$ and a partition
$P$, let $m_i$ and $M_i$ be the infimum and supremum of $f$ on
$[x_{i-1},x_i]$. The lower and upper Darboux sums are
$L(f,P)=\sum_i m_i(x_i-x_{i-1})$ and
$U(f,P)=\sum_i M_i(x_i-x_{i-1})$. Refining a partition can only
increase lower sums and decrease upper sums.
